name: ibis Bangkok Siam Ratchathewi
short_description: A budget ibis just a 1-minute walk from Ratchathewi BTS station, sharing its building/address with the adjacent Mercure Bangkok Siam Ratchathewi.
ai_summary: ibis Bangkok Siam Ratchathewi is a centrally located economy hotel just a 1-minute walk from Ratchathewi BTS Skytrain station, in the same Siam-Ratchathewi complex as the adjacent Mercure Bangkok Siam Ratchathewi. The area offers easy access to shopping, dining, and sightseeing, plus a mix of art attractions and traditional culture. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 199 Phaya Thai Road, Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, 10400 Bangkok, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability
